# crates_stack MCP tool

> Pick crates from the ranking for a goal in words (for example `web API with Postgres and auth`) and return the choices with reasons and a Cargo project…

Source: https://docs.aphrody.com/mcp/crates-stack/

Pick crates from the ranking for a goal in words (for example `web API with Postgres and auth`) and return the choices with reasons and a Cargo project skeleton.

## Call it

```json
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "method": "tools/call",
  "params": {
    "name": "crates_stack",
    "arguments": {
      "goal": "<goal>"
    }
  }
}
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `goal` | `string` | yes |  |

## Input schema

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {

      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "goal"
  ]
}
```
